explication: BirdNET-Go is a self-hosted, real-time wildlife sound analyzer. Audio sources feed capture and analysis, where installed classifiers produce detections that are stored, exposed in the web interface, and evaluated for alerts. The interface also supports configuration, analytics, imports, and system operations. README statements establish the product workflow and major capabilities; source excerpts show selected audio, model, alerting, storage, and server responsibilities. Several UI and integration relationships are documented but their implementation was not sampled.
